items.title: Huang pitches Nvidia comeback, WSJ reports SEC probing the chipmaker
items.summary: WASHINGTON/SAN FRANCISCO, Nov 17 (Reuters) - Jensen Huang said on Tuesday he "would be honored" to return as Nvidia's CEO if the chipmaker's board decided the move was in the best interests of shareholders and employees, and the Wall Street Journal reported a regulator was probing Nvidia. The US Securities and Exchange Commission was investigating Nvidia, the Journal reported, citing people familiar with the matter.

items.title: Coca-Cola Stock (KO) May Struggle to Repeat Its Strong 2026 Performance
items.summary: Coca-Cola (KO) stock may struggle to repeat its strong 2026 performance, as reported revenue growth could slow next year and its valuation leaves limited room for further gains. Shares of the beverage maker have soared in 2026, with investors cheering accelerating revenue and earnings growth after a weak 2025.
